title: Refactoring
meta: We clean up tangled code in one part of your app so new features take less time. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Refactoring that makes new features faster to build
overview: We pick the part of your code that slows your team down, such as a tangled module or a file nobody wants to touch, and clean it up without changing what users see. We add tests first, then restructure in small steps so each step can be checked. You get tidier code, clearer names, a short note on the new structure and a list of what to tackle next.

pkgs.blurb: Tidy one messy module, protected by tests.
Up to three modules cleaned, with duplicate code removed.
A larger clean-up with a shared structure and a team guide.
list: Test coverage raised on touched code

faq: Will the app behave differently afterwards?
It should not. Refactoring changes the structure, not the behavior. We add tests first and run them after every step, so any difference shows up straight away and is fixed or reversed.
No. If there are none, we write tests around the module before touching it. This is part of every package, because refactoring without a safety net is how bugs get shipped.

Rewrites take longer than planned and lose lessons hidden in old code. Cleaning up one painful area at a time costs less and keeps the product shipping. We tell you honestly if a rewrite is the better path.
How do you choose what to refactor?
We ask where your team loses the most time, then check the code for size, repeated logic and how often files change. We agree the target with you before we start.
